feedback_interpretation: Recent feedback supports prioritizing finish-sensitive ratio and loading effects, especially where loading-solvent volume and weak eluent may interact. Simple aromatic controls are included to distinguish transferable condition effects from scaffold-specific late retention and record dispersion.
batch_rationale: The batch covers simple controls, aromatic carbonyls, heteroaromatics, sulfur-containing compounds, esters, and multifunctional scaffolds across strong and weak PE/EA ratios, DCM, PE, and EA loading solvents, with multiple loading amounts and loading-solvent volumes. This should improve generalization by exposing the retrained model to separate onset and finish responses across chemical families and loading contexts while repairing underrepresented high-retention regions.
